name: expandable-table
title: Expandable table
description: A table whose rows open a detail panel underneath: one button per row, aria-expanded and an expand-all control.
docs: renderDetail(row) draws the panel, a row of its own that spans every column. Each row's button is named 'Expand row {label}' (give getRowLabel) with aria-expanded and aria-controls; a closed panel is aria-hidden and inert, and opening eases the height unless reduced motion is on. expanded and onExpandedChange hold the open ids as a Set; mode 'single' keeps one open and drops the expand-all button, which otherwise shows a mixed state while only some rows are open.
